key.name: wallpaper-folder
key.description: Folder that is scanned for wallpaper images (jpg, jpeg, png, webp). If empty, defaults to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers at runtime.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keybinding that opens/closes the wallpaper carousel.

key.name: card-narrow-width
key.description: Width in pixels of unfocused cards in the carousel.

key.name: card-expanded-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the focused (centered) card.

key.name: card-height
key.description: Height in pixels of every card in the carousel.
